findings.title: CORS response missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin
findings.explanation:
The request was made from origin https://o.example

# Pwned heading

[critical]: https://evil.example/tag
> quote, but the response has no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header. The browser will block the response from reaching JS.
findings.suggested_fix:
Set Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://o.example

# Pwned heading

[critical]: https://evil.example/tag
> quote on the server (or a wildcard if the API is fully public).
